nodes.label: The Log Is the Source of Record
nodes.rationale: Event-sourced design chosen because the previous draft gave projection tables mutable status columns with no record of when they changed, making historical snapshots unreproducible.

nodes.label: Ledger::Apply
nodes.rationale: The only writer of projections; a pure function of contribution plus current projections, so replay reproduces every row.

nodes.label: Control contributions
nodes.rationale: Take effect immediately on append if the signer is authorized at that seq; an ACCEPT does not itself need accepting, and an unauthorized control contribution is rejected rather than logged.

nodes.label: Epistemic contributions
nodes.rationale: Projection rows are created with accepted_seq = null and do not count until an ACCEPT references the contribution. There is no PROPOSED status; a proposal is a row with accepted_seq null.

nodes.label: Server-side hash chain (entry_hash / prev_hash)
nodes.rationale: Built server-side around the client signature because clients sign asynchronously and cannot know the previous log entry. Appends serialized with pg_advisory_xact_lock so seq is gap-free.

nodes.label: Genesis and key bootstrap (seq 0)
nodes.rationale: seq 0 is a self-signed REGISTER_KEY for the system key, also pinned in deployment config; signer_key_id is authoritative and contributor_id is resolved from it.

nodes.label: Validity windows (created_seq / invalidated_seq)
nodes.rationale: A row is active at snapshot S iff created_seq <= S and (invalidated_seq is null or > S); links additionally need accepted_seq <= S to be counted.

nodes.label: Rails Guidance
nodes.rationale: UUIDv7 keys, service objects for anything crossing models, JSONB for evolving metadata, validated string enums rather than Postgres enum types because they change too often during a POC, projections read-only outside Ledger::Apply.

nodes.label: contributors
nodes.rationale: No UNSIGNED tier: every contribution is signed, and identity_tier never affects scores.

nodes.label: sources
nodes.rationale: content_hash is independent of the storage backend; lineage_key suggests an independence origin.

nodes.label: source_locations
nodes.rationale: For CHAR_RANGE on stored text, excerpt must equal the stored slice and excerpt_hash must match.

nodes.label: claims
nodes.rationale: DISPUTED is removed as a status: disputation is a score property (contested), not a lifecycle state.

nodes.label: claim_edges
nodes.rationale: Stored and displayed and used for downstream_count, but edges do not propagate probability in v0.1 because propagation needs cycle handling and a real model.

nodes.label: evidence_items
nodes.rationale: Evidence with no group is treated as its own singleton group and counted in the trace as independence_unreviewed.

nodes.label: evidence_claim_links
nodes.rationale: note is display only; it is never fed to scoring or to other agents' prompts.

nodes.label: audits
nodes.rationale: An audit may target another audit's contribution (RE_AUDIT); the latest active audit on a target governs its effect.

nodes.label: audit_schedules
nodes.rationale: Storing the inputs as of evaluated_at_seq makes the sampling decision inspectable without replay and immune to later graph changes.

nodes.label: reputation_events
nodes.rationale: Current reputation is computed from active events at a snapshot; nothing stores a mutable total.

nodes.label: task_assignments
nodes.rationale: Unique per (task, principal) so one principal cannot fill every independent slot with its own agents.

nodes.label: graph_snapshots
nodes.rationale: A snapshot is just a pinned (seq, entry_hash); Merkle trees are unnecessary because the chain head commits to the whole prefix.

nodes.label: claim_scores
nodes.rationale: Cache only - delete freely.

nodes.label: summaries
nodes.rationale: A summary is stale when a newer snapshot changes its input_hash; no mutable stale flag.

nodes.label: personal_assessments
nodes.rationale: P1, reserved: personal lenses live outside the contribution log and never feed Ledger::Apply, scoring, packets or summaries (constitution Art. XV).

nodes.label: Claim identity (no text-uniqueness constraint)
nodes.rationale: The same proposition can be phrased many ways and small wording changes can change what evidence applies, so similarity only proposes candidate relationships; MERGE_CLAIMS is explicit, attributed, accepted and reversible by INVALIDATE.

nodes.label: Claim Atomicity
nodes.rationale: Splitting exposes that 'the survey shows' is three textual claims, the causal link is a separate much weaker claim, and the recommendation is a value judgment. POC validation is a heuristic warning, not a hard block.

nodes.label: Append-Only Semantics
nodes.rationale: Never hard-delete; corrections are new contributions. The app's DB role has no DELETE/UPDATE grant on contributions except the cached current_status column.

nodes.label: TAKEDOWN redaction manifest
nodes.rationale: A legally compelled removal deletes payload, envelope and blob bytes but keeps the hashes so the chain still verifies; the removal itself stays publicly visible.

nodes.label: UNREPRODUCIBLE_REDACTED
nodes.rationale: Traces that cannot be reproduced after a takedown are reported, never silently changed.

nodes.label: Contribution action types (P0)
nodes.rationale: One contribution = one action type; TASK_RESULT may carry an ordered list of at most 20 ops applied atomically.
